verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a CLI coding agent that exposes headless JSON Lines output and scripting interfaces, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions API versions, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, and the changelog items cover features only, not deprecation commitments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
